title: odontites glutinosus
intro: Odontites glutinosus, commonly known as the Downy Toothwort, is a plant species within the family Orobanchaceae. This hemiparasitic perennial is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Odontites glutinosus include its use in treating coughs, colds, and bronchitis, with its bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides and phenolic acids contributing to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and potential interactions.
